title: Package Deductible Cap on Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Claims
content:
**Package benefit.** On a Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage claim, the option deductible is capped according to the package the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy is written on: on a policy written on Cardinal Auto Premier the option deductible is capped at 500; on a policy written on Cardinal Auto Preferred it is capped at 750; on every other package the option deductible stands uncapped. The cap is the first thing applied to the option deductible, and the figure it gives is the capped deductible.

The package is read from the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy record the vehicle is scheduled on.

## Cap by package

| Package of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy | Cap on the option deductible (USD) |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Auto Premier | 500 |
| Cardinal Auto Preferred | 750 |
| Cardinal Auto Plus | No cap |
| Cardinal Auto Standard | No cap |
| Cardinal Auto Basic | No cap |
| Cardinal Auto Essential | No cap |

A cap only lowers: the capped deductible is the lower of the option deductible and the cap.

## Illustrations (hypothetical option deductibles)

| Package | Option deductible | Capped deductible |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Auto Premier | 1000 | 500 |
| Cardinal Auto Premier | 500 | 500 |
| Cardinal Auto Premier | 250 | 250 |
| Cardinal Auto Preferred | 2000 | 750 |
| Cardinal Auto Preferred | 750 | 750 |
| Cardinal Auto Preferred | 500 | 500 |
| Cardinal Auto Plus | 2000 | 2000 |
